profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Sequel Med Tech
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled Software Development, Cloud Computing, DevOps, Kubernetes, and agile development practices. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from the University of New Hampshire.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Full-stack developer

positions.title: Lead Cloud Engineer
positions.description:
Software Developer, Task Lead, and Technical Lead for various software projects within the space of Federal Enterprise IT research and development. Successfully led the design and implementation of rapid prototypes and reference architectures to inform and advise our government sponsors in developing software systems with new, cutting-edge capabilities that effectively use public resources. Led the design and implementation of data pipelining systems using AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Kafka, and custom Python applications using DevOps methodologies to include Infrastructure as Code.

The MITRE Corporation is a non-profit that operates several Federally Funded Research and Development Centers (FFRDCs) which are committed to innovation, problem solving, and systems engineering with the sole purpose of serving the public interest.

positions.title: Group Lead
positions.description: Direct supervisor for a group of 6 - 8 individual contributors focusing on bringing Cloud, DevOps, Agile methodologies, and Cyber Security best practices to bear for the unique challenges presented by our end user communities.

positions.description: Skills: DevOps · Amazon Web Services (AWS)
